kinetic.title: KineticRotator Component
kinetic.desc: Continuous velocity-preserving Hermite kinematics with modular geodesic shortest-path interpolation. Chaining mid-flight rotations seamlessly absorbs momentum (C¹ velocity continuity) without jerky snaps or excess revolutions.
kinetic.timingModePropDesc: Dynamic duration proportional to arc distance. Velocity remains constant across maneuvers.
kinetic.timingModeFixedDesc: Strict Rubik-style step execution. Motion always finishes in exact fixed duration T regardless of distance.
kinetic.isokineticDesc: Isokinetic motion. Duration scales proportionally to angular distance: T ∝ |Δθ|. Angular velocity remains constant, so larger rotations take proportionally longer.
kinetic.isochronousDesc: Isochronous motion. Every impulse finishes exactly after a fixed base duration: t_end = now + T. Angular velocity scales with distance: ω ∝ |Δθ|.
kinetic.shortestPathDesc: Always rotates via minimal angular distance (≤ 180°).
kinetic.waveformDesc: Live visualization of position θ(t), angular velocity ω(t), and acceleration α(t) during momentum-preserving interpolation.
kinetic.theoryDesc: Formal physical classification of continuity classes and mathematical derivatives governing the rotation trajectory.
kinetic.rowAngleDesc: Position trajectory is continuous with smooth velocity transitions (no teleports).
kinetic.rowVelDesc: Velocity profile is piecewise continuous (C⁰) with finite, well-behaved momentum.
kinetic.rowAccelDesc: Jump discontinuities at boundaries due to piecewise linear acceleration approximation.
kinetic.rowTargetDesc: Target position changes discontinuously like a Heaviside step function.
kinetic.rowJerkDesc: Dirac impulse / infinite jerk at step instants, smoothed into C¹ motion by kinematics.
kinetic.propDuration: Base duration in ms for 360° rotation (or fixed T in fixed mode)
kinetic.propShortestPath: Whether to always pick shortest geodesic angular path (≤ 180°)
kinetic.propTimingMode: Kinematic timing mode: 'proportional' (v ~ const) or 'fixed' (T = const)
kinetic.propInertia: Angular threshold in degrees to sustain momentum on direction reversal
kinetic.propSize: Size of rotator viewport in px
kinetic.eventFrame: Fired on every animation frame with normalizedAngle, velocity, acceleration
kinetic.eventSettled: Fired when rotator comes to complete rest at target

mutatingHeader.title: MutatingHeader Component
mutatingHeader.desc: Dynamic morphing header that transitions from full-width hero bar into a floating glassmorphism island upon scrolling.

props.threshold: Scroll distance in px to trigger docking
props.hysteresis: Scroll distance in px below which header undocks
props.stuckRadius: Corner radius when docked (default: 11px 11px 0 0 or CSS var --stuck-radius)

slots.center: Search inputs, telemetry metrics, segmented tabs

events.unstick: Emitted when header returns to floating card

switch.title: NanoSwitch Component
switch.desc: A lightweight, high-performance toggle switch with smooth cubic-bezier physics, zero browser outline rings, stationary hover feedback, multi-color presets, and full indeterminate tri-state support.
switch.triStateDesc: When indeterminate="true" or modelValue="null", the knob smoothly morphs into a centered horizontal pill capsule over a neutral track.

props.modelValue: Checked state (boolean) or null for indeterminate
props.label: Accessible label text

events.updateModelValue: Emitted on state change with new boolean or null value
events.change: Standard change event emitted on user toggle

codeEditor.title: NanoFileList & NanoCodeEditor
codeEditor.desc: Composable Git & Code inspection primitives with modular, separately importable language parsers and 8 selectable syntax highlighting color profiles.
codeEditor.sec1Title: 1. Git Unpushed Commit & Diff Inspector (NanoFileList + NanoCodeEditor)
codeEditor.sec1Desc: Click commits in the top bar or navigate changed files with ↑ / ↓. Switch between Unified and Split diff views, or pick any syntax color profile.
codeEditor.sec2Title: 2. Live Editable Code Editor & Modular Language Parsers
codeEditor.sec2Desc: Transparent textarea overlay synchronized 1:1 with Highlight.js Core grammar tokens, active cursor line tracking, 2-space Tab indentation, and on-demand language parser modules.
codeEditor.sec3Desc: Import only the language grammars your application needs to keep production bundles ultra-lean.

splitter.title: NanoSplitter
splitter.desc: Zero-clutter two-pane resizable splitter: features an ergonomic grab corridor, a crisp 1px electric cyan laser line on hover/drag, a flush edge triangle pull-tab lock toggle, double-click to reset, and keyboard arrow navigation.
splitter.sec1Desc: Hover between the two panels to reveal the #00e5ff laser line. Click the edge triangle pull-tab to lock/unlock dragging, or double-click the laser line to reset to default ratio.
splitter.sec2Desc: Outer horizontal NanoSplitter resizes NanoFileList dynamically, while the inner vertical NanoSplitter splits the diff viewer and live code editor.

knob.title: NanoKnob (Kinetic Rotary Dial)
knob.desc: Compact tactile circular rotary dial extracted from the 3D Donut Chart studio. Built on C¹ Hermite kinematics with geodesic shortest-path interpolation, center reset/readout hub, rim tick marks, and keyboard arrow control.
knob.sec1Desc: Drag the dial rim, click quick-angle steps, press ArrowLeft / ArrowRight (hold Shift for 15x step), or click the center hub to reset to defaultValue.
knob.sec2Desc: Combine multiple NanoKnob controls with different sizes, colors, and center readout modes for compact hardware-inspired toolbars.

select.title: NanoSelect (Searchable & Filterable Select)
select.desc: Configurable single and multi-select dropdown with diacritic-insensitive live search filtering, keyboard navigation (ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Enter/Escape), custom badges, icons, color dots, and modal-safe Escape isolation.
select.sec1Desc: Open the dropdown and type to filter options (diacritic-insensitive: typing 'zolty' matches 'Żółty'). Use ArrowUp / ArrowDown and Enter to select.
select.sec2Title: 2. Rich Option Compositions & Modal Escape Isolation
select.sec2Desc: Pressing Escape while NanoSelect is open inside a NanoModal closes only the dropdown menu without accidentally dismissing the parent modal.

globe.title: NanoGlobe (Orthographic 3D SVG Globe & HEALPix)
globe.desc: Interactive orthographic vector globe with lightweight country polygons (WORLD_COUNTRIES_LITE), cartographic meridian/parallel graticules, equal-area HEALPix spherical tessellation (orders 0–3), geodesic great-circle arcs, and custom color palettes.
globe.sec1Desc: Drag the globe to rotate, click countries or HEALPix cells to toggle selection, and switch between theme presets and HEALPix tessellation orders.

colorPicker.title: NanoColorPickerOklch & Perceptual Contrast
colorPicker.desc: Perceptually uniform OKLCH color picker with interactive Hue/Chroma wheel, Lightness slider, real-time WCAG 2.1 AA/AAA contrast ratio verification, and format conversion (OKLCH / HEX / RGB).
colorPicker.sec1Title: 1. Interactive OKLCH Color Picker & WCAG Contrast Inspector
colorPicker.sec1Desc: Drag the marker across the Hue/Chroma disc and adjust perceptual Lightness (L). Notice how OKLCH preserves subjective brightness across all hues.

maskedInput.title: NuMaskedInput & NuPinInput
maskedInput.desc: Zero-dependency hybrid masked text input and 2FA PIN verification control with single native input accessibility, live slot guide overlay, clipboard paste sanitization, and countdown expiration timer.
maskedInput.sec1Title: 1. NuPinInput — 2FA / OTP Verification with Countdown Timer
maskedInput.sec1Desc: Type digits or paste a 6-digit code. Automatically triggers @complete and @submit when all slots are filled.
maskedInput.sec2Title: 2. NuMaskedInput — Declarative Mask DSL & Custom Tokens
maskedInput.sec2Desc: Supports # (digit), A (uppercase), a (lowercase), L (letter), X (alphanumeric), H (hex), and custom regex token definitions.

trendChart.title: NanoTrendChart & Configurable Vertical Bands
trendChart.desc: Generic multi-series SVG chart with C¹ Catmull-Rom splines, dynamic kinetic Y-axis scaling, configurable vertical highlight bands (single SAT/SUN or merged SAT–SUN, frequency zones, algorithmic steps), and floating glassmorphic tooltip bubbles.

kineticEngine.title: Kinetic Animations Engine (Headless C¹ Hermite)
kineticEngine.desc: Timer-agnostic mathematical kinematics engine powering Nano UI animations: 1D scalar & angular C¹ Hermite transitions (createKineticTransition), multi-point curve resampling (createKineticPoints), cubic Bezier spline generator (buildSplinePath), and 16-step bisection curve inversion (evaluateSplineY).
kineticEngine.labTitle: 1. Multi-Point C¹ Resampling & Bisection Curve-Rider Laboratory
kineticEngine.labDesc: Switch node counts (N = 5 ↔ 12 ↔ 24) or trigger mid-flight impulses. The engine preserves each knot's velocity vector without discontinuities, while the violet rider dot tracks the exact Bezier stroke via 16-step bisection.
kineticEngine.hermiteTitle: 2. C¹ Hermite Basis Curves & Exported Primitives
kineticEngine.hermiteDesc: Comparison of transition trajectories for initial velocity v₀ < 0 (counter-momentum absorption), v₀ = 0 (rest easing), and v₀ > 0 (forward momentum boost).
kineticEngine.prim1Desc: Continuous 1D scalar/angular controller with C¹ velocity preservation and mid-flight retargeting.
kineticEngine.prim2Desc: 2D point-array controller with automatic linear resampling when sample counts change (e.g. 7d ↔ 30d ↔ 90d).
kineticEngine.prim3Desc: Catmull-Rom to cubic Bezier SVG path builder (open strokes, closed loops, or area fills to groundY).
kineticEngine.prim4Desc: 16-step bisection solver inverting cubic Bezier x(t) to guarantee exact curve-riding Y coordinates.
